thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging: control-plane elevated 5xx rate (auth + org-lookup). Alerting threshold crossed: 5xx rate 6.8% over last 3m. Paging sre-oncall. Link: https://telemetry.redwood/alert/5622223333
sre-oncall: On it. Are errors evenly distributed? Any regions?
maria-g: Seeing spikes concentrated in us-west-2 and eu-west-1, mostly for /v1/auth/validate and /v1/org/lookup endpoints. Latency spikes ~1.2s before 500s. Error body: "upstream timeout" and "cache-miss concurrency".
josh-t: Confirming. Graph: https://telemetry.redwood/graph/ctrlplane/auth-5xx — org-lookup cache hit rate dropped from 99% -> 60% 10m ago. Could be a cache TTL rollout or a new config.
alex-p: I rolled a small config change to org-lookup TTL (from 30m -> 0s) 12m ago during dev testing, might be the culprit. I can revert but need approval for quick rollback on prod.
rachel-support: Customer impact — some downstream customers reporting UI errors and timeouts when opening org pages. CS triage: 12 customers with high priority flags, estimated 5–10% error surface. We should communicate an incident banner.
sre-oncall: Action plan: 1) Temporarily revert org-lookup TTL change (alex) 2) Scale auth replicas + add immediate circuit-breaker to org-lookup calls 3) Re-enable prefix KV cache for auth tokens 4) Notify customers and execs. Who can run the rollback?
alex-p: I can run the rollback now. Command: 
```
kubectl -n controlplane rollout undo deployment/org-lookup --to-revision=3
```
I'll patch the ConfigMap TTL back to 1800s afterwards.

maria-g: While alex rolls back, I'll increase auth-service HPA min replicas from 2 -> 6 to absorb peak: 
```
kubectl -n controlplane scale deploy auth-service --replicas=6
```
Also toggling KV cache on auth: PATCH /config -> "kv_cache.enabled": true

josh-t: Adding a temporary ingress rate-limiter rule to smooth bursts for org-lookup: applied rule id rl-ctrl-5622. Should cut down downstream retries.
devops-bot: Deploy started: rollout undo org-lookup (pod rollout id: run-5622223340). HPA update queued.
incident-bot: Note: on-call escalation rules - if not resolved in 15m will escalate to senior-sre.

maria-g: Rollback confirmed, org-lookup pods are stable (ready=3/3) and cache hit rate climbing back to ~98% in 90s. 5xx rate dropping from 6.8% -> 1.6% across control-plane.

rachel-support: Notifying affected customers with interim status and ETA 30m for further verification. Draft message: "We're investigating elevated errors for org pages; a config change was rolled back and traffic is stabilizing. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Approve? :mailbox_with_mail:
sre-oncall: Approved. Post that to status.redwood.com and CS channel.

josh-t: Observability note: traces show org-lookup timeouts were cascading to auth validation because auth waits on org metadata enrich. Pushing a short-term fallback to skip enrich on high-latency path (non-blocking) — patching auth code now.
alex-p: Patch applied as a feature-flagged fallback: auth will return basic token validation if org lookup exceeds 500ms. Flag id: ff-auth-org-fallback.
maria-g: After fallback + cache rollback + HPA, global 5xx rate is now 0.4% and user-facing errors reported by CS dropped to 1 customer.

product-ops: Customer impact summary for comms: "~7% peak request failure across control-plane for 12 minutes, root cause was an accidental TTL rollback that removed org-lookup caching causing stampede -> timeouts -> cascading 5xx. Mitigation: config rollback, scale-up, ingress rate-limit, fallback behavior. Customers with persistent issues are being contacted."

sre-oncall: Next steps: - Keep elevated watch for 60 minutes - Schedule a postmortem action owner list - Create a permanent guardrail in deploy pipeline to prevent zero-TTL config to prod (automated lint). Who volunteers for postmortem?
josh-t: I'll own the postmortem write-up and RCA, will include timeline and telemetry.
alex-p: I'll own the deploy-gate change and add ConfigMap validation to CI.
maria-g: I'll follow up on runbook updates (cache stampede section) and add playbook steps for fallback flags.
rachel-support: I'll draft customer-facing postmortem and coordinate with CS for follow-ups.

devops-bot: Alert cleared: control-plane 5xx spike normalized at 5622223699.
incident-bot: Incident status -> stabilizing. Incident runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/incidents/cache-stampede. Page resumed normal. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: Marking this thread as handled; handing off to oncall for the next 60m observation window. If anything reappears, react with :pager: to re-open.

rachel-support: Adding notes to ticket tracker INC-562222: impacted customers list and CS messages.

product-ops: Action items recap in ticket: 1) CI guardrail for TTL 2) Postmortem (josh) 3) Runbook update (maria) 4) Deploy linter (alex) 5) Customer comms (rachel). ETA for postmortem draft: EOD PST.
sre-oncall: Thanks everyone. Good rapid coordination. We'll follow up on blameless RCA.
incident-bot: CLOSED INCIDENT 5622223333 - control-plane cache-induced 5xx cascade - status: mitigated - duration: ~18m - responders: sre-oncall, maria-g, josh-t, alex-p, rachel-support
